## Summary

Describe what changed and why it belongs in the reusable skeleton.

## Validation

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bun run format:check`
- [ ] `bun run test:unit`
- [ ] `bun run --bun build`
- [ ] Playwright run when browser behavior changed

## Security / compatibility

- [ ] No secrets or credentials exposed to browser code
- [ ] No legacy SvelteKit 2 patterns introduced
- [ ] `.env.example` and docs updated when configuration changed
